name: cap_electrolytic
display: Aluminum electrolytic capacitors (SMD + leaded + horn-type + hybrid)
__comment_why__: Added 2026-07-07 (power-electronics expansion): cheap bulk capacitance. Buckets: 'Aluminum Electrolytic Capacitors - SMD' (~5.1k), '- Leaded' (~7k), 'Horn-Type' (~0.6k), 'Hybrid' (~50). Like cap_polymer this MIXES mount styles, so the same smd ternary flag applies — filter smd = 1 for reflow-able parts. Ripple current here is specced @120Hz (mains-frequency convention), NOT @100kHz like polymers — don't compare the two columns across recipes directly.
columns: __comment_ripple__: '40mA@120Hz' — condition dropped, so values are the 120Hz
rating (multiply by the datasheet's frequency coefficient for 100kHz duty).
__comment_esr__: key exists on ~56% of sampled parts but the value is usually
literal '-' (skipped at merge) — expect LOW coverage, genuinely. Liquid
electrolytics rarely publish ESR; use cap_polymer when ESR matters.
